points.left: Named factions divide baptism and proclamation. 1 Corinthians 1:10–17 belongs to Corinth and contested apostleship.
points.right: Shared mind begins with regard for another. Philippians 2:1–4 belongs to Freedom, unity, and imprisonment letters.

points.label: Pattern for shared purpose
points.left: Named factions divide baptism and proclamation. Now I beg you, brothers, through the name of our Lord, Jesus Christ, that you all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you, but that you be perfected together in the same mind and in the same judgment. For Christ sent me not to baptize, but to preach the Good News—not in wisdom of words, so that the cross of Christ wouldn’t be made void.
points.right: Shared mind begins with regard for another. If therefore there is any exhortation in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any tender mercies and compassion, each of you not just looking to his own things, but each of you also to the things of others.
